## 📞 Call Summary Generator

**What this workflow does:**
Accepts a call transcript (text) or audio file URL, generates an AI-powered structured summary with action items, sentiment, and CRM-ready notes.

**Setup steps:**
1. Trigger via webhook POST with transcript text or audio URL
2. Add Claude API credentials
3. Optionally connect to CRM (HubSpot/Salesforce) to auto-log call notes
4. Set Slack webhook to notify the sales/support team

**Payload format:**
```json
{
  "transcript": "Agent: Hello, how can I help?\nCustomer: ...",
  "agent_name": "Priya",
  "customer_name": "Rahul",
  "call_duration_mins": 12,
  "call_type": "support|sales|onboarding"
}
```

**Tip:** Use Whisper API to transcribe audio first, then feed into this workflow.
